_comment: Near-duplicate articles merged into one survivor. Each 'from' is excluded from every listing, the search index and the sitemap, and answers a 301 to 'to': in nginx (scripts/gen-redirects.mjs writes it into public/_redirects.map) and in the article route itself. Survivor = the longer article, unless the longer one is held back by [VERIFY] tags while the other is live. The loser's unique sections are listed in ADSENSE_CHANGES.md for moving into the survivor in Strapi; unpublish the loser there once they are. Paths are full site paths, category slug included.
